title_en: Koreans eat a $4 dinner — no waiter, no tip 🍙 #shorts
description_en:
In Korea, a 편의점 (pyeonuijeom) is not just a store — it's where dinner happens. Cup ramyeon, triangle kimbap, a drink: about $4. Hot water, the microwave, even the seat by the window are free. No waiter, no dishes, no tip.

Stock footage: Pexels (free license)

hook_fil: Oo. Apat na dolyar. At walang tip.

hook_voice_parts.text: Yes. Four dollars. And no tip.
